languages.text: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

text.formatted: Whenever the golem is subjected to fire damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the fire damage dealt.
text.plain: Whenever the golem is subjected to fire damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the fire damage dealt.

text.formatted: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.
text.plain: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

text.formatted: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
text.plain: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

text.formatted: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.
text.plain: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

text.formatted: The golem makes two melee attacks.
text.plain: The golem makes two melee attacks.

text.formatted: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.
text.plain: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

text.formatted: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 23 (3d10 + 7) slashing damage.
text.plain: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) slashing damage.

text.formatted: The golem exhales poisonous gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
text.plain: The golem exhales poisonous gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
